import sys
from typing import Any, overload

if sys.version_info >= (3, 13):
    from typing import TypeIs
else:
    from typing_extensions import TypeIs


@overload
def ovc(x: int) -> TypeIs[int]: ...
@overload
def ovc(x: Any) -> TypeIs[Any]: ...
def ovc(x: Any) -> Any:
    return x


def overload_version_conditional() -> None:
    ovc(1)
